caption:
Most shops never build a follow-up process. They rely on memory and good intentions.

A lead calls in, you mean to follow up, the day fills up, and the lead goes cold without anyone deciding that.

Black Arrow built a free AI tool to fix this. Tell it about your business and it drafts a real follow-up sequence, the structure that usually takes weeks to build inside a CRM.

No signup. No card. Just your numbers and a sequence you can run this week.
